root_idea.summary: The root centers on breaking, crushing, or shattering.
root_idea.development: The Quranic usage extends physical breaking into a figurative expression for destroying or annihilating a people or settlement, especially one characterized as unjust.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested Form I verb is presented under its normalized perfect-tense dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: To shatter, crush, or break; in the Quranic usage, to destroy or annihilate.
senses.usage_conditions: In وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ, the imagery of breaking or crushing expresses the destruction of a town and its people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant identified as Artemisia abrotanum, or southern-wood; قَيْصُومٌ ذَكَرٌ is also used, while قَيْصُومٌ أُنْثَى denotes santolina.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical name and its specified plant-name variants.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Botanical lexical entry represented as a Classical meaning under its own headword.
